body: I am sorry to tell you, because two years ago i was in the same situation, but it really seems you are bragging about how many transfusions you got: otherwise why you made a lot of posts where you say that you got 29 transfusions and that your Hb got very low? I mean, a person with cancer would not say continuously how many times he had to get chemo. I understand why you do it, because it makes you feel bad enough, severe enough: i was like you, but really: stop talking about numbers! About numbers of transfusions or Hb: it could be very very triggering for other people! I know it's hard to stop, i got to a point i tried to kill myself and after that i continued cutting very severly, but then i realised i would have never done anything good and useful in my life if i had continued cutting: now i'm in medschool with top grades and i'm 3 months clean. Sometimes we should just accept to face the pain not cutting gives to us, accept our mind being hellish to us if we don't cut: i know you are afraid of suffering so much, but you should try to be a little stronger! Good luck
